versions.changelog:
Initial release – introduces a structured five-dimension analysis guide.

- Guides users to analyze complex issues through five sequential dimensions: history, interests, power, confrontation, and essence (史经政军哲).
- Follows strict single-question interaction per turn; proceeds only after user answers.
- Integrates nested five-layer analysis for deeper exploration when information is unclear.
- Provides a final panoramic report summarizing findings for all analyzed dimensions.
- Allows flexibility for users to skip, jump between dimensions, or stop at any point.
